'''Brynjaks''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] used as mounts during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TGB" /> Brynjaks were often hunted for their thick hide and sharp teeth, however they were a quarry that would challenge even experienced hunters.<ref name="item">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Armored Brynjak|Galactic Seasons 7}}</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brynjaks first appeared in the [[August]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''. Players can obtain brynjaks as a mount in the Galactic Seasons 7 "The Greatest Bounty" event.
